name: 3D Coordinate Grid Generation
aliases: Voxel Grid Sampling for Mesh Extraction
definition: Generates a 3D grid of sample points within a voxel space for SDF evaluation.
summary: 3D Coordinate Grid Generation produces a regular 3D lattice of sample points within a specified voxel space, differing from 2D grid generation by explicitly handling the third dimension and supporting arbitrary voxel resolutions.
